profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer  I thrive in collaborative team environments, bringing a positive attitude to every project. Known for my dedication to delivering high-quality solutions, I am passionate about leveraging technology to solve complex problems. Let's connect and explore the exciting world of software development together!

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
I build and maintain the core authentication platform powering login, SSO, MFA, and account management for millions of users across US,
  Canada, Australia, and Europe.

  What I do:

  • Design and ship authentication features end-to-end across multi-region production environments
  • Architect security solutions including brute-force protection, rate limiting, and AMS token caching at scale
  • Lead platform modernization efforts such as the TRex tenant management adoption
  • Resolve production incidents fast — SSO misconfigurations, authentication upgrade failures, and complex user state issues affecting live
  customers
  • Unblock teams, provide technical guidance, and mentor engineers across the org

  How I use AI to move faster:

  • Use Claude Code with MCP servers (Jira, GitHub, Confluence) and custom Skills to automate tasks, accelerate triage, and generate accurate
  outputs — all from the terminal
  • Apply CLAUDE.md context files and project-scoped instructions to reduce token cost while keeping AI outputs precise and actionable
  • Advocate for and help shape AI tooling adoption across our engineering culture

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design, build, and maintain secure, high-performance authentication and identity systems serving millions of global users.

• Develop and manage Auth0 Custom Database Connections, SAML authentication, and enterprise connection configurations.
 
• Lead tenant migrations to Custom DB Connections, ensuring seamless integration with AMS and dependent applications.
 
• Design and implement secure authentication flows, including SAML Request Templates and Signing Certificate Overrides for enterprise connections.
 
• Work with Spring Boot (Java 8–21), Kubernetes, and Concourse CI/CD to deploy and maintain authentication services.
 
• Troubleshoot and optimize identity-related systems, including debugging CMD and Adapter architecture issues.
 
• Monitor and manage certificate lifecycles using InfluxDB and Grafana.
 
• Drive NFR performance testing to resolve latency, contention, and scalability issues.
 
• Collaborate across teams to enhance security, stability, and observability of authentication systems.
 
• Mentor engineers and guide architectural decisions to deliver reliable, cloud-ready solutions.

positions.title: Senior Web Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and optimized stateroom availability and fire zone calculations, ensuring accurate room assignments and availability tracking.

- Designed and implemented decision models using DMN FEEL expressions, working within an older DMN version with limited support for modern FEEL functions.
- Utilized Scala, Java, Kubernetes, and SBT to build and deploy scalable applications.
- Worked with proto3 for structured data exchange in microservices-based architectures.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to enhance system reliability and ensure compliance with business logic and regulations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led mobile app backend development, implementing microservices and RESTful web services for optimal user experiences.
- Orchestrated REST integrations with external APIs such as Auth0, Moxo, OneSignal, and Twilio.
- Built and maintained REST APIs with a solution-oriented mindset, meeting strict deadlines.
- Spearheaded the transition to event-driven microservices with CQRS, significantly boosting system efficiency.
- Served as a technical lead, collaborating on innovative solutions with managers and architects.
- Provided training and mentorship to 8 developers, fostering a collaborative and knowledge-sharing environment.
- Executed surgical Java 7 monolith modifications, demonstrating precision and problem-solving skills while optimizing the codebase.

positions.title: Senior Java Engineer
positions.description:
• Integrated legacy apps for the Crew Department at Southwest Airlines (SWA) using Spring  
• Built an operational data store (ODS) which solved information issues at SWA’s Maintenance Department
• Maintained a 97% test coverage in all projects by leading the developer team via code reviews
• Led the team that implemented Java 8 features in ongoing projects
• Developed leadership and negotiation skills while being part of SWA’s architecture team
